$comment: Reviewed high/critical npm advisories (production deps) that are not exploitable here. Each entry MUST expire; CI fails on any unlisted high/critical advisory and on expired entries. Prefer upgrading over extending.

entries.reason: SQL injection via improperly escaped identifiers needs sql.identifier()/sql.raw() with dynamic input; none exist (git grep). Fix: upgrade to >=0.45.2 (0.x breaking).
Memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections; Fastify bodyLimit (1 MiB) caps input and cart arrays are .max(42). Fix: migrate to zod 4.
Pulled in by next for build-time CSS; never processes user-supplied CSS at runtime. Fix: Next 16 upgrade.
OTel is off unless OTEL_ENABLED=true (Terraform default false). Fix: upgrade OTel packages together.
Transitive via @opentelemetry/sdk-node; OTel disabled by default. Fix: upgrade OTel packages together.
DoS on malformed Jaeger header; Jaeger propagator not configured and OTel disabled by default. Fix: upgrade OTel packages together.
OTel disabled by default (OTEL_ENABLED). Fix: upgrade OTel packages together.
